title: python preset: implementer cannot rename a tracked file or list the index

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Observed 2026-11-11 (slicer s453, ork-20261111-213809-376f): the implementer under `ork projects set slicer --preset python` was denied `git -C <worktree> ls-files -s tests/fixtures/relay-contract-v11.json` and `git mv tests/fixtures/relay-contract-v11.json tests/fixtures/relay-contract-v12.json` while doing the slice's own fixture rename; the run went on. Wanted: decide whether the presets allow `git ls-files` (read-only) and `git mv` (index-only, no commit), or say in the brief that a rename is a plain move the landing picks up.
